## 9. Camping Covelo — best atmosphere and panoramic lake views

**Location:** Via Covelo 18, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.campingcovelo.com/>  
**2026 season:** 30 April–26 October  
**Shoreline:** about 300 m

Covelo is one of the most consistently praised campsites around the lake. The official site says the pitches are arranged so that **every pitch has a lake view**, with lakefront, second-, third- and fourth-row categories. It has a restaurant/pizzeria, bar, minimarket, free Wi-Fi and bicycle/boat rental.

For SUP rental, the current position is straightforward: the current official facilities list **does not mention SUP rental**. That makes Covelo excellent if you already have an inflatable SUP, but not the best choice if you need a board waiting for you on site.

Recent reviews are unusually consistent: guests praise the staff, cleanliness, restaurant and views. The repeated minor negatives are that the sanitary facilities are somewhat older and that road/rail noise can be audible depending on the pitch.


**2 September booking note:** Exact live inventory is not publicly readable. The published 2026 ACSI rate starts on 1 September but is limited to fourth-row pitches; premium lake rows are excluded. See the consolidated availability/price table above.

**Booking / price list:** <https://www.campingcovelo.com/> · <https://www.campingcovelo.com/prices-list.html>

**Best for:** own-SUP travellers, relaxed atmosphere, lake views from almost anywhere, longer stays.  
**Downside:** no verified on-site SUP rental; some transport noise; current prices are less transparent online than at Punta d’Oro/Pilzone/Cave.

---

## 10. Camping Iseo — best quiet sandy beach; no dogs

**Location:** Via Ippolito Antonioli 57, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.campingiseo.it/en/home-english/>  
**2026 season:** 28 March–18 October *(confirmed independently on Camping Iseo’s own 2026 tariff page)*  
**Scale:** 56 pitches

Camping Iseo is a genuinely separate site from neighbouring Camping Quai. Its official site describes a **fine-sand beach with a gentle gradient**, two lake-access ramps/jetties and a very quiet, garden-like setting. This is arguably one of the best places for launching your own SUP, especially if you prefer sand to a wall, steps or pebble edge.

Peak 2026 pricing is **€28 small pitch, €36 medium, €40 lakefront, €54 XL**, plus **€14.50 per adult and €3 electricity**. A lakefront pitch for two adults therefore comes to roughly **€72/night before tourist tax**.

Rules are stricter than elsewhere: **dogs are not allowed**, ACSI is not accepted, and the site says tents/closed awnings/grass carpets are not accepted.


**2 September booking note:** Live inventory is not publicly exposed; confirm directly. The campsite remains in its top tariff period on 2 September. See the consolidated availability/price table above.

**Official site:** <https://www.campingiseo.it/en/home-english/>

**Best for:** quiet couples, own-SUP users, sandy/shallow access, walking into Iseo.  
**Downside:** no dogs, strict camping rules, relatively high peak-season total price.

## 11. Sassabanek — best large leisure complex and ACSI option

**Location:** Via Colombera 2, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.sassabanek.com/en/>  
**2026 season:** 1 April–4 October

Sassabanek is a large complex rather than an intimate waterside campground. It combines Caravan Camping with the Sporting Lido, pools, sports facilities, restaurants and a marina. For SUP users, the key point is that its 2026 material explicitly advertises **SUP and kayak rental** through Sporting Lido/ATLS. The Sporting Lido is scheduled to remain open through **6 September 2026**, so it is operational for a 2 September arrival.

For 2 September, keep three separate price mechanisms distinct:

- **Regular tariff:** 23 August–20 September is the normal middle band: **€21.50 standard pitch / €25.50 large pitch + €11.50 per adult**, before tourist tax. €21.50 is a regular tariff, not itself a special offer.
- **September promotion:** from 1 September, stays of **5+ nights** receive **10% off the pitch component**.
- **ACSI:** the separate ACSI offer starts **6 September** and is advertised from €25/day per qualifying pitch. It does not help for the first nights of a 2 September arrival unless Sassabanek confirms that it can be applied part-way through the stay.

**2 September booking note:** Sassabanek is actively marketing September stays, but that does not prove a pitch is free on 2 September. Its separate September promotion starts on 1 September; ACSI does not begin until 6 September. See the consolidated comparison table above.

**September offer:** <https://www.sassabanek.com/it/fine-estate-lago-iseo>

**Best for:** facilities, families, low-season ACSI users, on-site water-sports access.  
**Downside:** less of the small, quiet “van parked almost in the lake” atmosphere that Covelo/Punta d’Oro/Pilzone provide.
